summary: Sprint F.B · Immersive Project Dialogue™ — Full backend + frontend validation. 11/11 backend pytest PASS. Frontend MilestoneDialogue mounts correctly under Design Journey™, renders all 10 editorial Italian CTAs (9 + free-voice), 10 chapter-kind pills, composer, voice composer, echo cards, and emits 'Voce del cliente · ...' narrative events into the EvolutionTimeline. ZERO forbidden lexicon terms found in live DOM. Atmosphere is cinematic editorial — no Jira/Asana/SaaS percezione.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS · Editorial Italian lexicon is consistently enforced both server-side (CHAPTER_LABEL/FEEDBACK_LABEL maps + 400 reject on unknown kinds) and client-side (no V1/V2/V3, no approve/reject anywhere).
PASS · Backend correctly persists rationale_json under projects.metadata_json.rationale_json (7 editorial keys) with idempotent merge semantics + rationale_updated_at timestamp.

PASS · POST /feedback and POST /versions emit narrative_text events on journey_timeline_events (event_type='client_voice' / 'chapter_added') using 'created_by' (no actor_id reference, schema-aligned).

NIT · The pytest fixture originally hard-pinned to the first project (no milestones in seed) — fixed to scan for a project with a moodboard_direction milestone. Recommend creating a stable seed fixture for E1 to keep tests deterministic.

OBSERVATION · MilestoneDialogue renders BELOW the EvolutionTimeline (DesignJourneyTab L478). UX-wise this means the curatorial conversation lives 'after the timeline' — works well editorially, but may want a soft anchor link from the active milestone card so users discover it without scrolling.

OBSERVATION · The CuratorialFeedback CTA column at 1440px renders as a tall vertical list of 10 buttons (right column). At narrower viewports it could feel like a long list — consider a 2-column chip layout above ~1100px for breathing room. NOT a blocker.
seed_data_creation: During UI testing I posted 3 real feedback rows (palette_works, embraces, palette_works) + 1 chapter 'Luce mediterranea / Evoluzione proposta' against milestone Moodboard Direction™ of project 80c5f050-b354-4051-8483-9e4c32d6b725. Plus pytest creates a few TEST chapters/feedback on that same project — totally safe (no enterprise vocab).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint F.B is solid end-to-end. Use project_id 80c5f050-b354-4051-8483-9e4c32d6b725 for any UI verification (has 10 milestones including Moodboard Direction™). For backend regression run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_100_milestone_dialogue.py — fixture now self-discovers the right project so it stays green. Forbidden lexicon scan on MilestoneDialogue subtree: ZERO hits (task/sprint/kanban/workflow/dashboard widget/ticket/todo/doing/approve/reject/V1/V2/V3/revision history/compare revisions/add comment/change request/pending review/upload center/attachment center/audit log/file management/review queue)
Forbidden lexicon scan on WHOLE page DOM (including sidebar/header): ZERO hits
Responsive: no horizontal overflow at 1280×800 or 768×1024
tests_executed.cinematic_perception_check: PASS — Dark warm charcoal background, italic serif headings ('I capitoli condivisi', 'Conversazione progettuale'), warm gold/beige CTAs with subtle borders, capitoli numbered 'capitolo · 01' in small-caps eyebrow, chapter_label as italic accent ('Evoluzione proposta'), rationale rendered as blockquote. Echo cards use tone-colored left border (embrace/curious/reorient/voice). Toast 'La voce del cliente è stata accolta' is editorial-warm, not 'Success!' generic. NO Jira/Asana/Monday/ClickUp/PM dashboard feeling detected at any point of the surface.

rca_of_the_issue: Initial 8/11 pytest failures stemmed from the fixture pinning to /api/projects?limit=1 — the first project returned by the API had no milestones (broken seed). Root cause: hard-coded ordering assumption in test fixture. Mitigation: rewrote fixture to first try the seeded preferred project (80c5f050-b354-4051-8483-9e4c32d6b725) then fall back to scanning up to 50 projects until one with a moodboard_direction milestone is found, with pytest.skip if none exist.
